title: Bryan S NDE 2528
content: I have had numerous occurrences, but they almost always start the same. Your back opposite of your solar plexus locks up, and then it runs down your legs where you cannot move, followed by up your shoulders and then down your hands where you cannot bend them. Next, it runs up your head and squeezes your ears to a high-pitched shrill, followed by the squeezing out of light in your eyes. Once your eyesight goes, it is a very quick point to the release from your body. I traveled up an upside down inverted hurricane tunnel that spun counter-clockwise that was filled with the brightest of bright neon colors from the brightest sunsets from clouds that were also wrapped in the bright light of fire flames that did not burn. As I traveled up, the white light and aqua/royal blue colors increased. You could see your body prism/shadow, although you really had no body to speak of. You just thought it was there but it was not kind of like an amputee having to scratch their stub for an itch on their 'foot.' Once I got to the top of the hurricane, I was in the inside of a globe-like room that also spun counter-clockwise with twelve portals or 'windows' that also let in light. Not that I am a Bible person, but I think those were the twelve gates. My life pictures flashed through the holes of the globe and going up in the inverted hurricane that got smaller in width as I traveled upward. The life pictures were divided into three categories with eighteen good life experiences with respect to people and your life, eighteen bad deed pictures that you regret, and eighteen nature pictures of your favorite beaches, travels, sunsets, etc. My good pictures outweighed my bad pictures, probably because I had an NDE at such a young age and kind of knew the rules to that 'game.' The globe or 'judgment room' had walls that spun fast and seemed to be made out of water from the brightest colors of water from the best coral reefs on earth but far brighter. Up above or at the ceiling, there was a golden triangle from which the brightest of lights came from, and there were these star beings that fly or swam in the densest of lights. As they collided, they made this reverberating love feeling like the ripple effect when someone throws a stone into water but this was love not water. It sprinkled down onto you and is the single greatest type of love that I have ever experienced. The remaining portion of the ceiling was created by the bright fire and cloud bank but did not burn and actually went sideways from the triangle to the 'water walls.' All the while, your life pictures are flashing brilliantly through the light. It ends very abruptly and brutally with a very deep and painful fall back into your over-charged body. They seem to get more difficult to get over and not easier, and you become more detached from living on earth and not less each one you have. They are a 'heavenly blessing' but an 'earthly curse.' It's never the same after that visit. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: Various (several 8, 13, 15, 17, 36, 37) NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Accident Surgery-relatedAllergic reaction Life threatening event, but not clinical death I have had several, but the most recent involved complications after a post-surgery. I probably had ten to twenty episodes in a very condensed period. I inadvertently kept a journal about some of them and have tried to clean it up to make more technical/scientific sense of it. My earliest was about eight when I almost choked to death jumping a fence and getting my coat caught on the fence. How do you consider the content of your experience? Wonderful Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal Everything is so pure up there. All are silent, and there are no lies. There is no time, and there are no games. There is no 'self' or isolation. All beings up there are for the same cause and are one giant bond that are effectively the greatest creation of the universe - just not the 'physical universe' the anti-matter of the universe so to speak. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When viewing the groups of eighteen life pictures. Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Neither There was no time, because there were no choices. No one ages, because it is eternal. Were your senses more vivid than usual? Incredibly more so Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. You see, but you don't see with eyes. The light is way too bright, and the way your 'being' or soul works up there is different from earth. It is like communication. They talk or communicate, but they don't use mouths or verbal words. It's kind of like Billy Idol's 'Eyes Without A Face' - 'They've got no human race, you're eyes without a face'. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. There really is no 'hearing.' There is communication but not verbally. Everything is silent with communication coming from within. No communication, no lies, heaven. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes Talked about above. Did you see any beings in your experience? Sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes The beings were in the light and resembled small moving stars about the size of a golf ball but made of electro-static light that was brighter than the lights of the heavens. They are what are referred to as 'angels,' but they don't have human bodies like those sold in stores on earth. Then again, who would buy a star-looking thing. You don't need legs after walking on earth, and there is no ground up there. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Technically, it was like a haze it's a light but it is so dense that it is almost water. It is somewhere in-between the two substances but is neither. It's not either, because it is both oneness and love. It is God, Heaven, and the Universe, and I am not a church going person nor will I ever be. Why, I saw the right place. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Clearly mystical or unearthly realm My last NDE, I really was gone and blew past the gate or triangle a way deep into the light. There are clearly three levels of Heaven. The light at or near the top is so intense you can barely survive in it. It is like this high powered electro light jet slide ride of water-like love that is somewhat like traveling through a wormhole or a really big water slide / tube on earth. You look up into Heaven at the lowest level. There are no actual divisions, but I do not think that your being can survive in the denser or higher levels if you are not supposed to be there. What emotions did you feel during the experience? Love, oneness, glory, peace, serenity, no time, eternal bliss. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? United, one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Past flashed before me, out of my control See above. It's really odd. Some of your life pictures you would never guess, yet they make perfect sense and really shaped your life. For example, one of my bad pictures was when a girl gave me too much money at a fair booth when I bought food and I walked away. She caught my eye and knew what happened but I never made amends. That haunts me to this day, particularly after almost dying. It was just one of those teenage things but certainly makes you think about future actions. And, my daughter's smile and hug was in there to but in the good category. The pictures rotate from good to bad to nature and repeat the cycle once all eighteen of each group are shown. I wrote down or remembered just about all to get the eighteen-count after having so many NDE's so quickly. Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? A barrier I was not permitted to cross; or 'sent back' to life involuntarily God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Moderate raised both Baptist and Presbyterian, although I really don't follow the churches anymore. They are all too much like non-profit corporations to me Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Liberal None Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Neither Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Sensed their presence Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes 'For every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction.' If we currently live in the 'physical universe' that is filled with matter, then the second place is the 'anti-matter' place or Heaven and Hell. You don't have your body but you exist. Death is a really bad name for what happens to us in the future. Deceased on earth is more appropriate. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I am not good with relationships anymore. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No But, words do not do it justice. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes I am not better off. I cannot be around many people and seemed to have developed some form of mental Turrets when around others. I used to be very social. I only like being outside and in nature and not around cities or people. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Primarily the love on the other side that is unconditional as well as the oneness with the universe. Love on earth falls dramatically short after seeing the light. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes It does not matter what they think. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes But, I have not really studied it like I have this past year. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real I didn't really have time to think about it at that point. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real I am certainly not afraid of death. I arguably want to die as soon as possible but not in a suicidal way. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? It was incredible to see the other side, and I would gladly do it again even if it were only for a few seconds. Having said that, it makes you lonelier here. Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? I think that you could divide the NDE portion from leaving the body, to the tunnel, to the 'gate', to the light, if you wanted and make it more overall accurate. I have done it often enough that it always goes in that sequence if you follow the light. If you don't go up, then there's that hovering effect over your own body, which is not really the same thing.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Physical sequence described: back opposite solar plexus 'locks up' → paralysis down legs/arms/head; ears squeezed to high-pitched shrill; eyesight lost; then 'a very quick point to the release from your body.'

tunnel.passage_other_detail: An 'upside down inverted hurricane tunnel' spinning counter-clockwise, filled with brightest neon colors; light increased (white and aqua/royal blue).
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Traveled upward through an inverted, counter-clockwise spinning 'hurricane' tunnel that narrowed as he went up.

arrival.other_being_detail: Star-like beings in the dense light, 'small moving stars about the size of a golf ball' made of electro-static light; he calls them what are referred to as 'angels' (not human-bodied).

environment.environment_other_detail: A globe-like spinning 'judgment room' with twelve portals/windows letting in light; walls like extremely bright reef-colored water; ceiling with a golden triangle emitting brightest light; remaining ceiling made of bright fire and cloud bank that did not burn and went sideways to the 'water walls'.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Multiple episodes across life: choking/accident as a child; surgery-related complications; allergic reaction; also described as accident and post-surgery complications; 'life threatening event, but not clinical death.'

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Raised Baptist and Presbyterian; currently 'None' (liberal none).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Describes a recurring sequence: leaving body → tunnel → 'gate'/triangle → light; also mentions an alternate 'hovering effect over your own body' if you don't go up.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: He states it 'always goes in that sequence if you follow the light'; if not, there is a hovering-over-body effect instead.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Reports numerous NDE occurrences (ages 8, 13, 15, 17, 36, 37; 'ten to twenty episodes in a very condensed period') with similar starting pattern and sequence.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Inverted, counter-clockwise 'hurricane tunnel' with neon colors and narrowing width; arrival into a counter-clockwise spinning globe-like 'judgment room' with twelve portals/windows; life review explicitly grouped into 18 good + 18 bad + 18 nature images cycling; ceiling golden triangle emitting intense light; star-like 'angel' beings colliding to create a 'reverberating love' ripple that 'sprinkled down'; description of 'three levels of Heaven' and a 'water-like love' wormhole/waterslide; abrupt, painful fall back into an 'over-charged body.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “It sprinkled down onto you and is the single greatest type of love that I have ever experienced.”
